plots.brief: Guild hall of the smiths at the NW corner, ~11x9 walls, two storeys, stone-brick plinth with pale stone above and dark deepslate roof. Hammer-and-anvil banner in deep blue over a spruce double door; a small forecourt with an iron-bar railing. Detail: a weathered copper bell turret on the gable.

Forge, ~11x9, two storeys: open-fronted workshop below with a big stone chimney at the back, home above. Plain stone bricks, dark oak frame, blackstone roof. Detail: glowing furnace and anvil visible from the street, soot-dark chimney top with campfire smoke.

Carpenter's house ~11x8, two storeys, spruce and dark oak timber frame on a low stone plinth, deepslate roof. Walled yard behind with stacked logs, saw trestles and a drying shed. Detail: a hoist beam with a hanging crate over the upper door.

Mason's lodge ~10x8, two storeys, pale stone and chiselled stone trim; a yard with stone blocks, a crane (spruce fence arm) and a half-carved column. Dark slate roof. Detail: statue in progress on a plinth by the door.

Foundry, ~12x9, wide two-storey hall in plain stone brick with two tall chimneys, blackstone roof, big arched double doors. Detail: casting pit visible through a grille and a stack of ingots; soot-stained walls (cobblestone and blackstone mix).

Glassworks at the NE corner near the river, ~11x9, two storeys, pale stone with a domed kiln chimney. Tall windows with stone mullions, glass panes displayed in the shopfront. Detail: stained-glass transom over the door and a copper-capped chimney.

Cooper's house ~9x10, two storeys on the low hill's flank, spruce and stone, dark roof. Barrels stacked in the side yard, hoops on a drying rack. Detail: a giant barrel used as a shop sign above the door.

Weaver's house ~10x10, two storeys on the hill, wool-white and gray plaster over stone plinth, dark roof. Loom room with big windows on ground floor, wool bales out front. Detail: blue and white striped cloth hung from an upper balcony.

Dyer's house ~10x10, two storeys, stone ground floor with spruce upper floor. Side yard of coloured dye vats (cauldrons) and a drying rack of hung wool in many colours. Detail: bright stains on the plinth and a deep blue banner.

Hill smithy ~10x9, two storeys, stone brick and dark oak, blackstone roof, tall chimney. Open forge bay facing the road, living quarters above. Detail: horseshoe and tool rack on the wall, a quench trough.
Tanner's house ~10x10, two storeys, plain stone and spruce, dark roof. Hide-stretching frames and a tanning pit in the yard at the east side. Detail: hides draped over a rack and a leather sign.
Wheelwright ~11x8, two storeys, spruce frame on stone plinth, dark roof. Cart wheels leaning in a yard and a half-built wagon. Detail: a big wheel mounted on the gable.

Chandler's house ~10x8, two storeys, pale stone with spruce shutters, dark roof. Candles in every window, rendering vats in a back yard. Detail: lantern-lit shopfront and bundled candles hung under the porch.

Open timber yard with a long stone-plinth office-house ~10x8, two storeys, spruce and dark oak. Stacked planks, a sawpit and a log pile on the north side. Detail: water-driven log pulley hints toward the pond.

plots.type: dye works near the mill pond
plots.brief: Dye works ~12x9, two storeys, stone with spruce upper floor and wide shuttered drying loft under the roof. Rows of drying racks with coloured cloth between this plot and the pond, vats by the door. Detail: coloured streaks on the plinth and a pulley for hoisting cloth.

Fulling mill ~12x9 on the river side, two storeys, stone ground floor and dark oak upper, with a water wheel on the east flank dipping toward the river. Stamping beams inside. Detail: the wheel and a sluice channel, wool hanging to dry on the roof lines.

Timber wharf on the river bank: a warehouse ~12x8 of spruce on a stone plinth, with a wooden jetty extending east into the river (raft logs tied alongside) and a crane arm. Detail: stacked rafts and a rope-and-lantern post at the jetty end.
